answer: I would stop farms with mutual TLS with a device certificate, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. An honest agent spends 13 minutes once; the operator of 429 fakes spends 5577 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. The comet test is the live device, the yarrow test is the locked stake, and the trellis test is the graded history no template can fake. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
